plans.description: Plan name to its Stripe price. The plan:<name> guard checks the tenant's active plan.

includes.description: Other plans this one satisfies in plan:x guards, e.g. team includes pro.

public_url.description: Public base URL of this API, for the webhook endpoint.

success_url.description: Where Checkout sends the browser after paying; {CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID} is filled by Stripe.

manage_permission.description: With rbac, the permission needed in a tenant to start checkout or open the portal for it.

api_base.description: Stripe API base URL; tests point it at a mock.
